FACTS (verified): The production sidecar is crates/ajax-web/sidecar/claude_sdk_sidecar.mjs (do NOT edit it). In production it is launched exactly as `node --input-type=module -e <FILE CONTENTS> ` (no extra args, so it resolves the REAL Claude Agent SDK through `import('@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk')` and then `$(npm root -g)/...`). Protocol: JSONL on stdin/stdout. Commands: `{"id":"1","type":"init","cwd":"<dir>","model":"haiku","resume":"<id>"?}` -> response `{"id":"1","type":"response","command":"init","success":true,"data":{"sessionId":..,"models":[..],"commands":[..],"initialization":..}}` or `success:false` with `error`; `{"id":"2","type":"prompt","message":"..."}` -> response data.disposition "started", then SDK messages stream as events (each its own JSON line with a top-level `type`: system, stream_event, assistant, user, result ...) until a `result` message; `{"type":"abort"}`; `{"type":"shutdown"}`. stdout lines are JSON; stderr is diagnostics. Split stdout on LF only.
The SDK uses the user's existing claude.ai login (no API key). Use the model alias `haiku` and trivial prompts to keep spend tiny.
